verdicts.reason: A keeps the product inside its cream circle, but has clear flaws: the subhead is nearly as heavy as the headline, wraps with an orphaned 'now.' and crowds the bottom edge. The NEW and Try It pills also float in a narrow strip on the right that isn't aligned with the text column. B has the same text and CTA problems and also breaks the hero image: the cream circle has been moved, cut off in the bottom-left corner, so the orange can sits invisibly on the orange background as a faint outline with a floating label.
